biography: Design manager at Hafez conslt Pocast host (a3det mohandesein )

name: Karim Morsy
title: Managing Director
biography: Dr. Karim Morsy, a licensed Professional Engineer (P.E.) registered in both Colorado and Kentucky, boasts an extensive career dedicated to climate change, sustainability and water resources. His multifaceted experience spans national and international landscapes across the public sector, United Nation agencies, academia, and the private sector, solidifying his status as a distinguished climate change and sustainability expert. With over four years serving as an Advisor to H.E. the Minister of Environment in Egypt, Dr. Morsy played a prominent role during Egypt’s COP27 Presidency. As COP27 Head of the Technical Team, he contributed to coordinating high-level efforts and preparing thematic days, Presidential Initiatives, technical studies, and strategic climate finance policy content that supported Egypt’s global climate leadership. Dr. Morsy’s professional journey includes key positions with major UN organizations, including UNDP, UN-Habitat and UNOPS, where he contributed to climate resilience, sustainable infrastructure, water management, and environmental planning initiatives across the region. His involvement in shaping the Nexus of Water, Food, and Energy (NWFE) national platform, derived from Egypt’s National Climate Change Strategy 2050, showcases his strategic thinking and leadership in climate finance and sustainable development. He actively contributed to multilateral coordination and building partnerships with MDBs, development institutions and private sector to mobilize climate investments. Dr. Morsy also serves as the Managing Director of Climate Consultancy, a leading sustainability and climate change consultancy that has delivered recognizable sustainability, ESG, and climate-related reports and advisory services for major regional and global leaders across multiple sectors. He also led impactful national projects, including the National Adaptation Plan (NAP) of Kuwait and the Kuwait Water Masterplan and Strategy 2040.

name: Karim Wassim
title: Chief Operations Officer
biography: Karim Wassim is a Chief Operations Officer and delivery leader who turns organizational chaos into working systems. Across 16 years in the EU, APAC, US, and MENA regions, he has worked inside Vodafone's global services organization, led enterprise delivery across 10 countries at Orange Business Services, and built and led a PMO spanning four business units at Majid Al Futtaim. He now serves as COO of PodMedia Network, running operations across Egypt, Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and Bahrain; where a growing share of his work involves using AI and automation to let small teams carry loads that once needed whole departments. Alongside his corporate roles, Karim has spent the past nine years inside Egypt's entrepreneurship ecosystem, running workshops, consultations, and capacity building programs for founders and early-stage teams. His work sits where corporate operational rigor meets the resource-constrained reality of startups, translating each into terms the other can actually use. He holds an MBA in International Business and is a certified PMI Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP) and Scrum Master. He is known for designing systems that respect how teams actually work rather than imposing process for its own sake; turning "we need structure" into frameworks teams genuinely adopt.

name: Ahmed Mansour
title: architect and conservation specialist
biography: Ahmed Mansour is an architect and conservation specialist with over 15 years of dedicated experience in safeguarding and revitalizing Egypt's cultural heritage. He received his Bachelor dregree from the faculty of Fine Arts in Cairo (2002) and his MSc in Conservation of Monuments and Sites from the Raymond Lemaire International Centre for Conservation, KU Leuven (2009). He is the founder of Mansour for Architecture and Conservation. His expertise spans the rehabilitation and adaptive reuse of historical buildings and the regeneration of traditional areas. Ahmed previously served as a key consultant for the UNESCO "Urban Regeneration for Historic Cairo" project, aiming at developing a conservation and management plans for the World Heritage Property. His expertise extends to major sites in Histroic Cairo, Heliopolis, downtown Cairo and Alexandria, where he has led extensive documentation, condition surveys, and adaptive reuse master planning to enhance visitor experience and economic sustainability. Complementing his practice, he is a part-time lecturer and is actively involved in several conservation and rehabilitation projects.

name: Mark Mouris
title: Senior Investment Analyst
biography: Mark Mouris is a Senior Investment Banking Analyst with over three years of experience in M&A and corporate finance across Egypt and the MENA region. He has worked on 30+ transactions across various sectors, including manufacturing, renewable energy, logistics, media, and healthcare, and has successfully closed five transactions across these sectors. Mark was also the winner of the 2023 CFA Research Challenge in the MENA region.

name: Waleed Rashed
title: Founder and CEO
biography: Waleed is the CEO and Founder of SIDEUP, an e-commerce logistics platform that connects online merchants to 15+ couriers in Egypt and Saudi Arabia through a single dashboard. Founded in 2019, SIDEUP gives sellers of any size the shipping capabilities of a large retailer with no contracts and no subscription fees. The company is headquartered in Cairo and Riyadh and is backed by 500 Global, Launch Africa, UPS Express KSA, Riyadh Angels, Alex Angels, and Core Vision Investments. Having worked with thousands of merchants across both markets, Waleed has a first-hand view of why deliveries succeed or fail and what separates sellers who scale from those held back by returns and operational gaps. He is an alumnus of Meet Silicon Valley, a U.S. Government-funded exchange program in San Francisco, and a regular speaker at entrepreneurship events across the region.

name: Emad Kattara
title: Founder and CEO
biography: Dr. Emad Kattara is a seasoned banking leader and economic expert with over 28 years of experience in the banking sector, complemented by more than 16 years of leadership in professional training and development through Banker’s Lounge Academy, which he founded as a leading platform for developing banking professionals and future leaders across Egypt and the region. He has held senior leadership positions at major financial institutions, including Barclays Bank, Arab African International Bank, and Bank Audi, where he played a key role in shaping strategic initiatives, enhancing institutional performance, and supporting transformation within the banking sector. Dr. Kattara holds a PhD in Digital Transformation and Financial Technology (FinTech), along with an MBA in Customer Service from the Arab Academy for Science, Technology, and Maritime Transport. His profile reflects a strong blend of strategic vision, digital innovation, and customer-centric excellence. Throughout his career, he has designed and delivered specialized training programs for most Egyptian banks, in addition to collaborating with the Egyptian Banking Institute, contributing significantly to the development of banking talent and institutional capabilities. Beyond his executive role, Dr. Kattara is a recognized media figure and thought leader, actively engaging in economic discussions and delivering insightful content through articles and interviews with top industry experts and decision-makers, playing a vital role in advancing financial awareness and professional impact.

name: Abdelhamid Dessouky
title: Senior Marketing Manager
biography: a senior marketing executive with extensive experience leading marketing strategy, brand transformation, customer experience, and growth across healthcare, life sciences, and consumer-focused organizations. I currently lead Marketing at Nawah Scientific, where I am responsible for shaping the marketing direction, strengthening brand and customer experience, accelerating digital transformation, and supporting business growth across Egypt and regional markets. Throughout my career, I have led multidisciplinary teams and strategic initiatives that connect customer insights with business objectives. My experience spans brand strategy, integrated marketing, digital transformation, customer experience, market development, and building marketing functions that deliver measurable impact. I believe the strongest marketing starts with understanding people, what motivates them, what influences their decisions, and what creates genuine value for them. My approach goes beyond promoting products and services to building meaningful experiences that turn attention into action, engagement, and long-term relationships.

name: Marwan Messiry
title: CEO
biography: Marwan El Messiry is a marketing and management consultant, corporate trainer, and MBA lecturer with extensive experience helping organizations translate strategy into practical business results. His work covers leadership development, strategic management, marketing, sales effectiveness, and organizational performance across healthcare, industrial, education, and consumer-sector organizations. He is the creator of The Effective Manager, a practical leadership-development program designed to help managers lead people, improve decisions, strengthen engagement, and deliver measurable results. Marwan combines academic insight with real-world consulting experience, making complex management concepts simple, relevant, and immediately applicable.

name: Ahmed Rashad
title: Founder of Business Belarabi platform and angel investor
biography: Ahmed Rashad is the founder of Business Belarabi one of the leading Arabic media, education platforms specialized business and career education, entrepreneurship, and leadership, alongside his work as an angel investor supporting early-stage ventures. He is also a transformation management and Strategy Consultant, and a certified executive coach, with additional roles as a leadership and management trainer and a contributing writer for Entrepreneur and Think Marketing Magazine

name: Khaled Alaa
title: Head of Experience & Operations
biography: Khaled Alaa is the Head of Operations and User Experience at Talabat Egypt, bringing more than 18 years of experience across e-commerce, marketplaces, logistics, and technology-driven businesses. In his current role, he leads operations, customer and vendor experience, compliance, and business transformation initiatives focused on driving operational excellence and sustainable growth.Prior to Talabat, Khaled held leadership positions at Jumia and MaxAB, where he played key roles in scaling operations, improving customer journeys, and building high-performing teams. He is also a founding board member of the Customer Experience Egyptian Association (CXEGA), contributing to the advancement of customer experience practices across Egypt.

name: Mona Arslan
title: Head of Digital & Assistant Professor of Marketing
biography: Dr. Mona Arslan is an Assistant Professor of Marketing & Media at the Arab Academy for Science, Technology and Maritime Transport (AASTMT), where she also serves as Head of Digital Content, leading the institution's digital content strategy and production. She holds a PhD from the University of Hull, UK (2020) and has served as a Development Specialist on a USAID and IU Indianapolis program in Cairo. Her research centers on marketing, digital communications and consumer behavior in Egyptian and Arab market contexts. Through her Arslan Trust Triad framework, she has guided brands, corporations, and NGOs in building credibility and authentic positioning. Her international teaching spans AASTMT, Marywood University, Roehampton, and Coventry. Dr Arslan is a Global Shapers alumna with the World Economic Forum and has spent over 12 years with Rotary International.Looking ahead, she aims to bridge research with actionable industry practice, empowering organizations to foster deep stakeholder trust through strategic, impact-driven communication.

name: Ziad Ashraf
title: RTG
biography: Ziad Ashraf is a Product Manager and Solution Architect at Robusta Technology Group, leading product across e-commerce, fintech, and PropTech engagements. His background bridges finance and product: he owned P&Ls and led FinOps at Talabeyah (Acquired by MNT-Halan) before moving into product, where he now builds both products and AI agents using AI-native tooling. Outside of work, Ziad is an avid sportsman who plays almost every sport he can get his hands on. His current focus is kitesurfing, after years of rowing and padel.

name: Ahmed S. ELSHEIKH
title: R&D Manager
biography: Dr. Ahmed, R&D Manager at ITIDA-SECC, helps executives and decision-makers shape their strategies in the disruptive digital economy using broad exposure to a wide range of strategies, business models, methodologies, frameworks, and technologies such as "AI, Data Analytics, FinTech, Metaverse, Business & Enterprise Architecture, Blockchain, Lean Six Sigma, TOGAF, CMMI, and Agile." He also helped them implement these strategies using strategy governance frameworks such as "Balanced Scorecards," "COBIT," and "Objectives & Key Results (OKRs)." He earned his "Executive Doctorate of Business Administration" dual degrees from SKEMA Business School & iaeLyon School of Management—France. Previously, he obtained an MBA from Warwick Business School—UK, and an MSc from AAST—Egypt. He has diverse experience as an R&D Manager, Advisor to C-suite executives, business and enterprise architect, and Executive Coach.

name: Tamer El Raghy
title: Managing Director
biography: Tamer has over 25 years of investment, entrepreneurial and innovation experience in Africa, Middle East, USA and Europe. As the founding MP of Acumen Resilient Agriculture Fund (ARAF); an impact fund that invests in fast-growing Agri companies with business models that help farmers in East, West and North Africa adapt to climate change, he led the team that invested in 14 companies that impacted more than three million farmers. Prior to joining ARAF, he led responsAbility AG (rA) Agriculture PE in Africa and Cargill’s growth strategy and investment activities in Africa. He received an MBA from NYU Stern School of Business, a PhD in Materials Engineering from Drexel University and a B.Sc. in Metallurgical Engineering from Cairo University.

name: Ann Adham
title: Professor of Marketing
biography: Dr. Ann Adham's career sits at the intersection of academia, consulting, and professional development. As a university professor, international trainer, consultant, and speaker, she bridges theory and practice across Public Relations, Marketing, Personal Branding, Luxury Brand Strategy, Communication, and Professional Presence. What drives her work is a simple belief: expertise alone is rarely enough. Success often depends on how effectively ideas are communicated, relationships are built, and value is perceived.

name: Hany Emad
title: Director
company: Medium, Small & Micro enterprises development Authority
biography: Hany Emad is a senior finance and investment executive with extensive experience in development finance, SME financing, venture capital and Fund of Funds investments. He currently leads MSMEDA’s Venture Capital and Fund of Funds Program, having played a key role in building the program’s investment strategy and institutional framework. The program’s portfolio comprises 18 private investment funds with aggregate capital of approximately USD 1.3 billion and MSMEDA commitments of around USD 60 million, with an expected USD 600 million to be invested in Egyptian companies. Previously, Hany established and led MSMEDA’s direct lending activity, building a portfolio of approximately EGP 2.5 billion. His leadership combines investment expertise, institutional development, strategic thinking and a strong focus on building high-performing teams and delivering measurable impact.

name: Oliver Roberts
title: Co-Director of the WashU Law AI Collaborative & Adjunct Professor
biography: Oliver Roberts is Co-Director of the WashU Law AI Collaborative, an Adjunct Professor of Law at Washington University in St. Louis School of Law, CEO & Founder of Wickard, an Adjunct Professor of Law at Case Western Reserve University School of Law, Managing Attorney at The Roberts Legal Firm, and the Editor-in-Chief of the AI & the Law publication at The National Law Review. Roberts regularly lectures on artificial intelligence and law at law schools in the United States and abroad. His commentary on AI policy, legal technology, and emerging technology issues has appeared in Bloomberg Law, The National Law Review, The Hill, and Law.com. He also regularly appears as an on-air television commentator on AI issues for media outlets including Fox News, ABC News 2 Nashville, Newsmax, and others. Roberts designed and taught the nation’s first required AI law school course at Case Western Reserve University School of Law, the nation’s second required AI law school course at Mississippi College School of Law, inaugural AI & the Practice of Law course at Washington University in St. Louis School of Law, and the first legal AI education program in East Africa at Addis Ababa University School of Law. Roberts also taught the nation’s first AI education and certification course in a paralegal program at Kapi‘olani Community College in Hawaii. As Managing Attorney of The Roberts Legal Firm, Roberts represents high-profile clients in litigation and advises clients on AI, technology, and emerging technology issues. His appellate experience includes two oral arguments and two victories before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Third Circuit, as well as securing a denial of certiorari from the U.S. Supreme Court that preserved one of those victories. His most recent Third Circuit victory, Culp v. Commissioner of Internal Revenue (3d Cir. 2023), resulted in a precedential opinion departing from nearly a century of Tax Court and appellate precedent concerning taxpayer compliance with the 90-day deficiency petition filing deadline. His first Third Circuit victory overturned a Tax Court decision that had imposed a six-figure tax liability on his clients. Roberts is a graduate of Harvard Law School and Villanova University. Roberts previously practiced at Skadden Arps and Jones Day.

name: Magdi Moussa
title: Co-Founder
biography: Magdi Moussa is the Co-Founder of People of AI and People of Data, Egypt's AI community and ecosystem, and the founder of Skew Creative Group, an AI-native creative studio. He leads Egypt's AI Film Festival (AIFF), a national AI filmmaking training program and competition, and is a co-founder of Dnaneer, a SAMA-licensed Saudi fintech. A Forbes 30 Under 30 honoree, Magdi works at the intersection of generative AI, product design and venture building, guided by one principle: creation over noise, systems over hype.

name: Ayman Elsawy
title: Founder & CEO
biography: A highly experienced financial expert with over 28 years of experience working in the financial industry, with a proven track record of providing strategic financial guidance to clients across Egypt and the Middle East, helping them unlock their growth potential and achieve their financial goals

name: Tawfik Mahmoud
title: CEO & Managing Director
biography: A firm believer that great companies are built by great teams, Tawfik brings over 2 decades of leadership experience across the fintech and digital payments ecosystem in the Middle East and Africa to his role as CEO & Managing Director of Taly. His experience spans launching and scaling operations, navigating complex regulatory environments, and driving large scale transformation initiatives across diverse markets in MEA. At the core of his leadership philosophy is a strong focus on empowering people, building high-performing teams, and delivering sustainable, long-term impact through disciplined execution and purposeful growth.

name: Sherief Kesseba
title: Managing Partner
biography: Managing Partner @ CLIMATE RESILIENT AFRICA FUND (CRAF). 25 years of experience investing across the agriculture & food chain in Africa.

name: Anna Pochikovskaya
title: Founder
biography: Anna Pochikovskaya opened her first business at 14 - an online healthy bakery in Belarus that still operates today as a family business. She has been building ever since: Germany, Malta, and now the Middle East. At 22 she founded WOMANIFEST, a conference and online platform for women's holistic wellbeing and leadership. It grew out of 30 events she hosted across 22 countries, each one built one personal invitation at a time. Today it runs two sold-out European editions, an international online community & educational platform, and — on 31 October — Cairo will welcome its Middle East & Africa edition: 600+ women at the National Museum of Egyptian Civilization, convening founders, investors, operators and cultural leaders. She is also a transformational coach and hypnotherapist. Her clients are founders and executives, and the work is the part of scaling that rarely makes it into a deck: identity, nervous system, and the capacity to hold what you have built while living a life of fulfilment. Born in Belarus, educated in Germany, with 25 trips to Egypt, — she chose Cairo, not Dubai and not Riyadh, as the place to build from.

name: Wakid Marrei
title: Chief People Officer & Board Member | People, AI & Organizational Transformation
biography: Wakid Marrei is Chief People Officer and Board Member at Nawah Scientific Group, where he leads the organization’s people strategy, leadership development, organizational transformation, and talent agenda across a growing regional and international footprint. With extensive executive HR and management experience across Egypt, the GCC, Europe, and Africa, Wakid has held leadership roles with multinational and regional organizations including the British Council, Al-Futtaim, Pepsico, Al Safi Danone, and Lafarge. His work sits at the intersection of people, business, leadership, and technology. He is particularly interested in how organizations can use talent intelligence, competency-based decision making, data, and AI to identify potential, develop leaders, improve organizational decisions, and build future-ready workplaces. Wakid is also the architect of Nawah’s People for Growth (P4G) strategy and has led the development of integrated talent, performance, competency, succession, and organizational development frameworks designed to translate business growth into sustainable people capability.

name: Seif Bahgat
title: Investment Manager & Director of Strategic Partnerships
biography: I bring over a decade of experience spanning venture capital, startup acceleration, media, and strategic partnerships with a focus on building founder-first platforms and driving meaningful innovation across the MENA region. Starting in digital media and marketing, I co-founded a creative agency that served clients like Giza Systems and Maker Faire Cairo, before transitioning into the entrepreneurship ecosystem. I spent five years at Flat6Labs, leading startup scouting, program design, and ecosystem partnerships. During that time, I reviewed 1,000 startups and helped design national initiatives in sectors like GovTech, AgriTech, and ConTech. As General Manager of Lantern Ventures, I oversaw operations, investments, and strategic growth helping the studio evolve from a startup builder into an impact-driven venture platform. Following a merger, I now serve as Chief Strategic Partnerships Officer, where I lead external collaborations and drive regional expansion. Today, I’m focused on deepening my impact in strategic partnerships and venture support with a long-term vision of helping shape founder-first platforms, expand regional collaboration, and contribute to sustainable growth across the MENA ecosystem. Let’s connect if you're working on something ambitious in the venture or innovation space.

name: Ahmed Sheta
title: CEO
biography: Ahmed Samy Sheta graduated from the Faculty of Medicine at Tanta University in Egypt in 2018, with honors and distinction. He moved to the UK, training as a clinical fellow at King's College Hospital and Southampton University Hospital and earning MRCS from the Royal College of Surgeons of England. He returned to Egypt to co-found Farapi, a software company. At Farapi, he built Qarar, an HR platform covering the full hiring and workforce lifecycle. He speaks Arabic, English, French, and German.

name: Mostafa Gabr
title: Founder
biography: I am an Egyptian productivity consultant and Founder of Be Productive Training & Consulting, with a methodology officially documented by the Egyptian Ministry of Culture under the field of psychology. I specialize in transforming chaotic workplaces into high-performance systems that double output and maximize efficiency. My work is centered on helping clients reclaim their time and focus through practical Time Management and Productivity Systems, building sustainable habits, not just theory. Over the past 5 years, I've helped more than 1,000 professionals and business owners reclaim their time and achieve peak performance across coaching, group programs, and corporate training. My clients consistently report 50 to 70% improvement in productivity within the first 2 months of implementing my proven systems. What I Do: Productivity consulting for company owners and executives at leading organizations including SUTRA, CURVA, GIB GAS, 99 AGENCY, and GLORIA. One-on-one consulting for over 200 professionals, transforming their mindset and work approaches. Corporate training programs that have impacted 100+ participants. Speaking & Training: As a 2x TEDx speaker, I've delivered impactful presentations at prestigious events including the Egyptian Ministry of Communications, Google Developers Groups, Alex Techne Summit, Cairo Techne Summit, ASU IHUB, and IEEE BUB SB. My mission is simple: help ambitious professionals and business leaders eliminate overwhelm, build sustainable systems, and achieve extraordinary results without burning out. Ready to transform your productivity? Let's connect and explore how we can unlock your peak performance together.

name: Ahmed S. ELSHEIKH
title: R&D Manager
biography: Dr. Ahmed, R&D Manager at ITIDA-SECC, helps executives and decision-makers shape their strategies in the disruptive digital economy using broad exposure to a wide range of strategies, business models, methodologies, frameworks, and technologies such as "AI, Data Analytics, FinTech, Metaverse, Business & Enterprise Architecture, Blockchain, Lean Six Sigma, TOGAF, CMMI, and Agile." He also helped them implement these strategies using strategy governance frameworks such as "Balanced Scorecards," "COBIT," and "Objectives & Key Results (OKRs)." He earned his "Executive Doctorate of Business Administration" dual degrees from SKEMA Business School & iaeLyon School of Management—France. Previously, he obtained an MBA from Warwick Business School—UK, and an MSc from AAST—Egypt. He has diverse experience as an R&D Manager, Advisor to C-suite executives, business and enterprise architect, and Executive Coach.

name: Ahmed El Alfi
title: Founder and Chairman
biography: AHMED EL ALFI Founder and Chairman of Sawari Ventures, named as one of the most creative people in the world by Fast Company, Ahmed El Alfi has been an early stage/growth investor for over 30 years, translating to an extensive experience in funding and nurturing early-stage companies. In 1990, he founded Hybrid Capital Partners, a private investment partnership. Hybrid Capital has funded, helped grow and exited several successful companies. From 2010 to 2013 he founded Sawari Ventures, Flat6Labs, Nafham, and TATP. Flat6Labs is the MENA region’s leading startup accelerator. Nafham is the top Arabic online video educational platform covering the Egyptian, Saudi and Syrian public school curriculums, Nafham has given over 100 million free video lessons to students. TATP took over management of half of the American University in Cairo’s Tahrir Square campus to form The GrEEK Campus; a 25,000 square meter office park where over 130 companies work and collaborate. In addition to Sawari Ventures’ portfolio of investments, his current portfolio includes NeuroTrainer, Pacific Toxicology, as well as Zignal Labs. Prior to becoming an early-stage investor in 1990, he was Senior Vice President of Jefferies & Company, where he worked for 10 years. He has served on the Boards of Directors or Advisors of several corporate boards as well as multiple academic institutions.

name: Sherif Kozman
title: CEO
biography: Sherif Kozman has spent 25 years in enterprise technology. He is the CEO of Extreme Solution, guiding organizations through governed enterprise AI adoption on Google Cloud, and founder of NAYA, the proof and control layer for money movement. Practitioner-builder. Building human and AI teams. A Human still in beta.

name: Hatem Sallam
title: Cofounder and CEO
biography: Hatem is currently the founder and CEO of EduSofx. “EduSofx Learning Buddy” provides AI Agents for Curriculum-Grounded Teaching and Learning. An AI-powered learning platform that lives inside your school's existing ecosystem—connecting to LMS, SIS, and content repositories to empower them with intelligent agents. With 30 years of experience, and a master’s degree in Organization Consultancy from Hult (Ashridge) in UK, Hatem is an impact driven leader who developed a proven track record of Leading transformational projects that changes peoples’ life. As a member of Global Alliance team for MBRGI Digital School in UAE serving 150K students in 12 countries and aiming to reach 1M in 3 years’ time. Hatem Led the Education Transformation efforts in EMEA large customers for Microsoft as a Principal Transformation Architect/Consultant. This involved solutions north of $500M. Before Microsoft, Hatem served as a Partner and Chief Growth Officer in Almentor.net (2018 to 2021, During this assignment, Hatem drove the growth strategy for this online platform that has more than 2.2 million visitors and 3 million visits during 2018 which was its first year of operation. In 2021, it almost tripled in terms of visits. 1M learning experiences were achieved on the platform and the company is a well-established video-based learning platform serving the Arabs needs around the globe with more than 15,000 high quality video-based learning experiences now. Before Almentor.net Hatem held many executive positions like the Chief Technology and Transformation Officer for the largest K-12 school chain globally GEMS Education. With many transformation projects in the K-12 learning business model. As well as the CEO for ITWORX Education where the company reached to 6 million learners on its platform. Hatem held management and technical position for Microsoft, IBM for almost 9 years in Egypt and Gulf Area. Hatem’s work in the Education and learning spaces impacted some deprived groups like Syrian refugees in Lebanon and Turkey as well as low-income families in east Africa. Hatem helped many nation-wide education transformation projects (e.g., BSF in UK in Durham and Kent, National projects for Education in Qatar, UAE, KSA, and Egypt). Hatem is sharply focusing on the opportunities to nurture people’s capabilities. Driving Impact in all fields is the main motivation. Hatem’s most important role is inspiring his three boys (28, 24, and13 years old) to be the best versions of themselves and find true meaning for life.

name: Omar Eleish
title: Managing Director
biography: Omar Eleish is a foreign direct investment (FDI) expert, economist, and entrepreneur with extensive experience supporting investment-led economic growth across Europe, Africa, and the Middle East. As Founder and Managing Director of ITI Integrating Economies GmbH, he advises governments, international organizations, and private-sector stakeholders on investment attraction, business expansion, and economic development strategies. His experience includes work with the World Bank Group, COMESA, and numerous national investment promotion agencies and economic zones. Omar brings practical insights into how startups, scale-ups, investors, and policymakers can leverage international expansion and investment to accelerate growth and create lasting economic impact.

name: Amr El Abd
title: Entrepreneurship Advisor to the Prime Minister of Egypt Regional Managing Director, MENA
biography: Amr El Abd works at the intersection of entrepreneurship, capital, and public policy, with over 25 years building the institutions that empower founders across emerging markets. In 2024, he was appointed Advisor to the Prime Minister of Egypt for Entrepreneurship, where he plays a central role in shaping national strategy to empower founders and drive innovation-led growth. He is currently co-designing and leading government initiatives to support the transformation of the entrepreneurship ecosystem. In 2025, he was appointed to the Board of Directors of MSMEDA, Egyptʼs apex authority for micro, small, and medium enterprise development. Mr. El Abd serves as Regional Managing Director for MENA at Endeavor, the worldʼs leading network supporting high-impact entrepreneurs across 50+ markets. He assumed the regional role in 2023 after serving as CEO of Endeavor Egypt, where he led the organization through a strategic repositioning that expanded its founder base and deepened its institutional partnerships. His policy and capital markets work spans more than a decade. As Senior Advisor to the World Bank, he supported the design and structuring of Egyptʼs first fund-of-funds program — a foundation he continues to build on in his current government role. He was previously the founding CEO and Vice Chairman of Egypt Ventures, the countryʼs first government-backed VC firm, and founding Chairman of Falak Startups, one of the regionʼs largest accelerators. He has also advised the Ministry of Investment on national startup and innovation policy. In 2002, well before entrepreneurship became a policy priority in the region, Mr. El Abd launched the Entrepreneurs Business Forum – Egypt (EBF), the countryʼs first nonprofit dedicated to empowering founders. He has co-founded ventures across technology, logistics, consulting, and education. He holds a degree in Economics from Georgetown University.

name: Islam Saadany
title: Managing Director
biography: I'm the Founder and Managing Director of Forefront Consulting and a strategy advisor to CEOs, founders, and boards. Over the past fifteen years I've worked with groups, enterprises, and mid- sized businesses in Egypt, the UAE, and Saudi Arabia; helping them turn complex challenges into structured, executable growth strategies. My focus is the hard part of strategy: execution. I help leaders cut through complexity , align their teams around a clear direction, and build the discipline that turns ambition into measurable outcomes. Beyond client work, I'm invested in the strategy conversation in the region — convening C-level leaders and strategy practitioners to share knowledge, challenge thinking, and raise the bar for how strategy gets done.

name: Sherin Wafaai
title: Project Manager & UX Lead
biography: Sherin's mixed background of Psychology, User Experience and Therapy allows her to see users beyond the interface. 10 years ago UX was about "How does it work?", now it's about "How does it feel?". Empathy is what allowed her to lead the UX research project on Egypt's Masr el Rakameya digital platform. She believes Ai can be the best assistant to free up time to do real research and design incredible intuitive experiences. She's also the co-owner of two restaurants, bäxters european kitchen and PaoPao | Edgy Asian. Still creating experiences, just more delicious ones!

name: Sally Mansour
title: Technical Advisor - Green Private Sector Development
biography: Sally possesses a diverse professional background, encompassing both the private sector and the development sector. In her current role as technical advisor for green private sector development in PSI II project she focuses on accelerating climate tech entrepreneurship in Egypt by strengthening entrepreneurial ecosystems and developing support measures that aim to de-risk early-stage investments. She is currently programme lead of the Egypt Climate Invest programme and ESO Climate Innovate Egypt programme. She has also led programs to build the capacity of manufacturing SMEs, facilitated public-private partnerships, and collaborated with startup support organizations on sustainable enterprise growth initiatives. Within the private sector, she has extensive experience in product management across multiple industries. She is also a certified expert in climate finance from Frankfurt School and an ESG (GRI) professional.

name: Mohamed Hussein
title: Head of Business Banking
biography: Mohamed Hussein is a senior banking executive with more than 20 years of experience across Business Banking, SME Banking, corporate banking, credit, and digital transformation. He currently serves as Head of Business Banking at Arab African International Bank (AAIB), leading the development and growth of the bank’s Business Banking franchise. Previously, he established and led AAIB’s SME Banking business and its digital transformation agenda, with a focus on building innovative banking propositions and positioning the bank as a long-term Growth Partner for businesses. Prior to AAIB, Mohamed held a senior leadership role at Banque Misr, where he established the SME Business Hubs model to expand financing for medium enterprises beyond Cairo and sponsored the development of the bank’s digital SME lending proposition, Express Loan. Earlier, he spent more than a decade with Barclays Bank Egypt, building extensive experience across commercial banking, credit, and relationship management. He also served as a Non-Executive Board Member of Sandah Microfinance, contributing to governance, risk, and audit oversight. Mohamed holds an MBA From AAST

name: Rafy Kourouian
title: Founder and Managing Director
biography: After a stint at his father’s gold business in Alexandria, Egypt, Rafy spent the first 15 years of his career in information provision for Middle East capital markets. Over the years, his career has ventured into journalism before assuming overall regional responsibility for ISI Emerging Markets, a multinational economic and financial database firm. Later, he provided development consultancy to both USAID, Canadian International Development Agency and UNIDO. This led to a pivot from traditional investment advisory onto innovative technologies, including renewable energy and fintech ventures. Rafy holds an LL.M. in International Business Law, University of Leiden, The Netherlands. He is also the holder of a B.A. with a Major in Economics and Political Science from McGill University, Montreal, Canada.

name: Hoda Kassem
title: Head of Operations Division
biography: Born and raised in Alexandria Egypt, started my career 33 years ago with HSBC Group, working in UAE, Egypt and with Global Shared Services. Moved to Emirates NBD in January 2025 to Head the Operations Division and drive the Operations Evolution agenda. Thru out my career I managed Operations, Branch Network, Contact Centres and Shared Services, with extensive expertise in Performance and Stakeholder. I worked on embedding strategies, delivering change, leading transformation, capacity management and adopting new ways of work. I have gained competency in people management, internal controls and fostering compliance culture, while driving end-to-end Customers’ Journeys and Customer Experience agendas. Appointed as a board member within HSBC Global Service Centre, in addition to ongoing facilitation of Leadership Programs and providing mentorship and coaching to Execs at different levels and Regions.

name: Basma Ammari
title: Director of Public Policy, Middle East and North Africa
biography: Basma Ammari is the Director of Public Policy for the MENA region at Meta. She leads a team that focuses on tech regulations and policies, promotes platform integrity, and supports innovation ecosystems. By practice, Basma is an international development and public policy professional with over 20 years of experience, having worked at the World Bank in Washington DC, Africa and MENA, as well as with social impact organizations and governments in those regions. Basma worked across several sectors and contexts, from education, to health to community development and across several countries, including in conflict and post conflict zones in West and East Africa and the Middle East. Prior to Meta, Basma served at the Prime Minister’s Office of the UAE as advisor in Strategy and Innovation. She has a Bachelors in Economics and Finance and holds an MBA degree.

name: Gehad Abdullah
title: Program Manager
biography: Gehad Abdullah is an entrepreneur and program leader with a decade of experience building businesses and supporting high-growth startups across Egypt and the region. She is the Founder of MerMaid, one of Egypt’s pioneering tech-enabled home services platforms, which she grew from the ground up into a multi-city business supporting thousands of service providers. Today, she is a Program Manager at Plug and Play, leading innovation and startup programs while connecting founders with investors, corporates, and growth opportunities. Her experience spans entrepreneurship, venture building, accelerator management, and ecosystem development, with a particular passion for helping ambitious founders turn strong ideas into scalable businesses.

name: Chris Abboud
title: General Manager
biography: Chris Abboud General Manager, Beyti - An Almarai Subsidiary Christian Abboud is an accomplished leader in the FMCG industry with over two decades of experience spanning four continents in both emerging and developed markets with a proven track record of driving growth, innovation, and operational excellence. Recently appointed as General Manager of Beyti, an Almarai subsidiary, Christian is poised to bring his visionary leadership to further strengthen the company’s market position. Before joining Beyti, Christian held senior roles at global powerhouses such as Nestlé, PepsiCo, and P&G. He is widely recognized for leading transformative business initiatives, expanding market presence, and implementing sustainable practices that deliver long-term value. His leadership style fosters high-performing teams that thrive on collaboration, passion, drive for results, and making a positive impact. His expertise extends beyond management to include board and chair roles, showcasing his commitment to shaping agile and future-ready organizations. Christian is a graduate of the American University of Beirut with a BA in Business Administration and has completed the Program for Executive Development at IMD, Switzerland, further sharpening his strategic and leadership capabilities.

name: Mehdi Taher
title: Head of Public Policy
biography: Mehdi Taher is the Head of Public Policy for North Africa at Meta, where he leads the company’s engagement on a broad range of policy issues across the region. His work spans regulation, technology policy, platform integrity, and innovation, with a particular focus on artificial intelligence. He engages with governments, industry leaders, and civil society to shape responsible and forward-looking approaches to technology governance. With a background as an economist and a former diplomat, Mehdi has worked across the Middle East, Africa, and Europe on political, economic, and strategic issues. He has held senior roles in the UK government, covering foreign policy, trade, security, and economic development. His experience includes engaging with international institutions, shaping policy initiatives, and navigating complex geopolitical and regulatory environments - expertise he now applies to the evolving landscape of tech policy.

name: Walid Al.Engbawy
title: DEMI & DECI Executive Director
biography: Al.Engbawy has 25+ years of experience in many fields such as Projects Management, Leading Training Programs (Communications, Information Technology and Management), Learning and Development. On the practical side, he participated and was involved in many National Projects in Egypt such as (but not limited to): • Professional Training Project for young Egyptian Graduates over 5 years that led to more than 35,000 ICT Professionals in the market during his work in Ministry of communications. • The ICDL "International Computer Driving License" Scholarship for the Government Employees over 3 years that led to more than 30,000 ICDL Certified Employees during his work in Ministry of State for Administrative Development . • Designing and supervision for countless of “Middle and Senior Managers Programs” in the field of Management for both public and privet sector for more than 40,000 trainees during his work in National Management Institute. He conducted and managed 500+ training courses in different ICT & Business areas including, but not limited to, IT, Project Management, Operations Management, etc. Received reputable certifications in training, facilitation and other technical aspects including, TTT Certified Trainer, Business, Telecom Certified Trainer, and others. He graduated from Communications & Electronics Engineering Dept., Faculty of Engineering and Technology, from the Arab Academy for Science & Technology & Maritime Transport (AASTMT) in Alex. 1997, later he completed Master studies in the field of Quality Management in 2012.Currently he is the Executive director for both DEMI and DECI affricated from MCIT that successfully conducted training programs for more than 250k students all over Egypt.

name: Ahmed Morsy
title: Founding Director, AI Research Lab
biography: Professor Ahmed Morsy is the Founding Director of the AI Research Lab at the Faculty of Engineering – Cairo University and former Chair of the Biomedical Engineering department at the same University. He is the Founder of Nebras Technology, an Egyptian venture which grew to be a leading regional provider of healthcare information management solutions. He received his Ph.D. in Health Technology from Duke University, USA. Dr. Morsy has held many lead and advisory roles in the healthcare technology management space. He was Lead R&D Engineer at Philips Medical Systems in Seattle, USA; and the General Manger of IBE Technologies. He later served as Senior Advisor on IT strategy planning to the Chairman of Egypt National Post Organization, Senior Director at SysDSoft (acquired by Intel), and Senior Program Manager at the Microsoft Innovation Center in Cairo leading the healthcare innovation team. He was also the Editor in Chief of the IEEE Pulse magazine, the flagship health technology magazine for the IEEE. Dr. Morsy is currently the Vice Chair of the Healthcare Governance and Transparency Association and also a member of the Investment Committee of Egypt Ventures (national VC with an investment portfolio of over EGP 1 Bn). Dr. Morsy has several international publications and 4 United States patents.

name: Nagy Iskandar
title: Founder / General Manager / Consultant
biography: Nagy Iskander is a seasoned investor, business leader, and entrepreneur with a distinguished 35-year career spanning finance, oil and gas, FMCG, and venture capital. As an active investor and mentor, he plays a pivotal role in shaping the future of high-growth startups and investment ventures across diverse industries, including Green Energy, Fintech, AI, E-commerce, Deeptech, and Agritech. Nagy’s investment acumen is rooted in a deep understanding of capital markets, deal structuring, and strategic growth. His expertise was honed during his tenure at BP, where he spent 22 years negotiating multi-million-dollar agreements with governments across Egypt, Trinidad, and the US. He also held key leadership roles as CEO of United Gas Derivatives Company (UGDC) and board member for BP Egypt, Natural Gas Vehicle Company (NGVC), and BP’s LNG, oil trading, and Castrol Lubricants divisions. His background in banking, including experience at the Export Development Bank of Egypt, further solidified his ability to navigate financial landscapes and assess high-value investments. As an angel investor, Nagy actively supports and funds startups through MINT Incubator, AUC Venture Lab, DarE Incubator, Raya, and Cultiv Ventures. His hands-on approach goes beyond capital injection—he provides strategic mentorship, leveraging his vast industry network and operational expertise to help entrepreneurs scale and secure follow-on investments. Beyond his investment portfolio, Nagy contributes to the financial and energy sectors as a lecturer at the Arab Academy for Science, Technology & Maritime and as a mediator at the Cairo Regional Centre for International Commercial Arbitration, specializing in complex dispute resolutions. He holds a B.Sc. in Engineering from Ain Shams University and M.Sc. in International Banking and Finance from Southampton University, UK. His career is a testament to his ability to identify high-potential opportunities, structure successful deals, and drive innovation through strategic investments.

title: Director of international patient department
biography: Medical doctor and Public health expert with 15+ years of experience advancing public and reproductive health, Healthcare system strengthening, contributed efficiently in health system reform in Egypt. Proven track record in designing and implementing large-scale health initiatives within the Universal Health Insurance System, including service delivery models, performance frameworks, and revenue cycle systems. Skilled in leading multi-stakeholder collaboration with government entities, UN agencies, and international partners to develop policy, strengthen health systems, and deliver measurable impact. Brings strong expertise in technical advisory, multi-stakeholder coordination, and translating data into policy and operational solutions. Committed to improving equitable access to quality reproductive health services and driving sustainable health outcomes for women and vulnerable populations.

name: Alison Cossette
title: CEO & Founder
biography: Alison Cossette is founder and CEO of ClariTrace, where she's building graph-based intelligence for AI systems. Her work spans AI governance, physical AI, and retrieval research—she recently won "Most Impressive Project" at Physical AI Hack 2026 for a VLA-powered robot that reads books to children. Alison serves on the US NIST Generative AI Public Working Group and has studied AI and Data Science at Northwestern University at the Master's level. She speaks globally on building AI systems that are capable, controllable, and worth trusting.

The first professional E-sports team baseg from Upper Egypt, were we managed to make first feminine E-sports team in Egypt, and also managed promote 6 professional teams in 6 differentgames. Ahmed studied business administration and management, also studied Finance and accounting , which helped to increase the investment in the organization so much. Studied E commerce, also managed to give alot of talks about E-sports fields , and how to develop your brand.

biography: I’m Adham ElKholy, 26 years old , Founder & CEO of ArmyVerse Athletes Nutrition, an Egyptian sports nutrition company focused on helping athletes improve their performance, recovery, health, and body composition through personalized nutrition systems. I graduated from Cairo University, Faculty of Engineering, in 2023, and founded ArmyVerse in 2024. Since then, we’ve worked with 4,000+ athletes across different sports, building ArmyVerse as a system-driven company that combines nutrition, data, technology, and continuous follow-up. I’m passionate about entrepreneurship, business growth, leadership, and building high-performance teams and systems.

name: Yasmine Shihata
title: Founder & CEO
biography: Yasmine Shihata, is an Egyptian and UK national, born in Kuwait who went to international schools in Vienna, Austria and Washington D.C. She attended university in London, where she graduated from the London School of Economics (LSE) with a degree in International Relations. Having had a passion for fashion, art and magazines from a young age, Yasmine interned at Vogue and Marie Claire magazine in London during her studies. Yasmine’s professional career began in New York City, where she joined Vogue magazine as senior assistant to the Editor in Chief, Anna Wintour. This demanding position exposed her to the corporate magazine world and the intricacies of magazine production and public relations at a young age, Yasmine then moved to Cairo and founded Egypt’s first English language lifestyle publication: Cleo magazine. Cleo magazine was a hit from its inception, as it tapped into a virgin market and the aspirations of Egypt’s emerging sophisticated and modern culture. Yasmine’s success in her first venture cemented her status as a pioneer in Egypt’s English language lifestyle magazine market. Yasmine then sold her shares in Cleo and went on to launch Enigma magazine: the Arab region’s glossy lifestyle magazine for sophisticated Arab men and women with an international outlook. Enigma quickly became the region’s leading English lifestyle magazine and expanded its distribution throughout the Middle East. eniGma was also the first magazine in the Middle East to be available in print and online, with a dynamic online platform that includes video clips of Enigma cover shoots, interviews, and photos from social events, as well as a comprehensive archive of past magazine features. With a market presence spanning 22 years, eniGma has become a leading pan-Arab lifestyle English language magazine, featuring the region’s most dynamic celebrities, entrepreneurs, fashion and interior designers, and trendy destinations. The magazine is distributed in Egypt, Kuwait, Abu Dhabi, Dubai, Bahrain, Qatar, Jordan, Oman, and London. Yasmine also launched Enigma’s PR and events division to bring the glamorous world of eniGma magazine to life in cities across the globe - and to date it is the only Arab media company to do so. The eniGma PR division has hosted exclusive events in Cairo, London, Dubai, New York and Los Angeles. The events included a 2000 person celebration at the foot of the Pyramids of Giza on the occasion of the 5th anniversary of Enigma magazine with a performance by Bryan Adams, followed by an even larger celebration of the magazine’s 10th anniversary, also at the Pyramids, with a performance by Kylie Minogue. Along with many other smaller events - with high profile guests such as Sir Richard Branson and former US president Jimmy Carter - in the international cities mentioned above. Enigma also organized the Cairo International Film Festival’s closing party sponsored by Bulgari and many other events in Cairo and beyond. Yasmine also set up another division, eniGma TV, which films exclusive celebrity and entrepreneur interviews, cover shoots, PR events, and the latest fashion trends, for eniGma readers online. Enigma TV videos can be viewed on Enigma’s website, social media platforms and its dedicated YouTube channel. Today Enigma Star is a digital platform with strong social media presence. In 2013, she launched an Arabic language sister magazine, eniGma Star, a pan-Arab magazine, dedicated to celebrity and fashion news and features. The magazine was created to target the pan Arab audience around the Middle East, with exclusive and stylish content. Today Enigma Star is a digital platform with strong social media presence. Enigma also hosts an annual Celebration of Arab Glamour & Success in both Beverly Hills, California, London and Dubai to highlight the best of the Middle East and to bring an exclusive selection of VIPs from the Middle East and around the world together. The events are always star studded and also feature the presentation of Enigma Achievement Awards, to honour leading Arab personalities and entrepreneurs who have had an international impact throughout their careers. Past awardees have included Naguib Sawiris, Mohamed Alabbar, Mohamed Hadid and many more. These successful events have helped promote a greater appreciation of Arab success and culture around the world and help bring the East and West closer together. After 25 years in the industry, despite the political challenges in the region, the Enigma brand has continued to grow and succeed due to Yasmine’s dedicated efforts and genuine love for her work. Her extensive experience has provided her with an invaluable understanding of exclusive content and media production, public relations, business development and an amazing database. Yasmine is one of the few Arab women in the Middle East who has created her own international business, a strong brand name and has become a pioneer in the Middle East’s lifestyle and entertainment media and PR industry.

name: Amr Bassiony
title: Creative Director
biography: Amr Bassiony is a Creative Director with over 20 years of experience turning challenges into ideas, concepts, and experiences. His career spans advertising, branding, events, and experiential design across Egypt and the Middle East, where he has led creative teams and developed work across a wide range of industries. Throughout his career, Amr has been particularly interested in the thinking behind the idea — how we move beyond the obvious, look at problems from different angles, and make unexpected connections that lead to stronger ideas. He believes creativity is not about waiting for inspiration or having a special talent. It is a way of thinking that can be practiced, developed, and deliberately applied. At the heart of his approach is a simple belief: good ideas don't just happen — they are made.

Throughout his career, Ahmed has worked across traditional banking and emerging financial technologies, with a strong focus on developing customer-centric investment solutions, digitalizing investment journeys, and building strategic partnerships with fintechs and technology providers.

biography: The Co-founder & CEO of Lucky, Egypt’s leading consumer fintech platform. In 2022, Lucky was recognized by forbes as one of the top 10 most funded fintechs in the middle east. Ayman also founded Connect Money, the rising banking one-stop-shop providing embedded finance as a service. As a serial entrepreneur in MEA region for over a decade & before embarking on the journey to build Connect & Lucky, co-founded Dsquares, currently the leading loyalty solutions provider in the region operating in 7 markets. In addition, Ayman's corporate career includes leadership roles at Vodafone & Temasek, angel invests & sits on the board of a few tech startups in Egypt. Endeavor Egypt entrepreneur & board member. Columbia business school alumni & studied electronics engineering.

name: Mohamed Kamel
title: Chief Executive Officer
biography: Most software leaders talk about digital transformation. I've spent 20 years actually building it at a national scale, in sectors where failure is not an option. I'm the CEO of Lumin Soft, where we architect and deliver mission-critical digital platforms for government institutions and financial organizations across the region. My path here wasn't a straight line; it was 20 years of engineering, leading, failing fast, and building things that had to work. I started as a Software Engineer straight out of Ain Shams University with a degree in Computer & Systems Engineering. I wrote code, managed teams, and eventually led as CTO before stepping into the CEO role. That full-stack career, technical to executive, is exactly why I lead differently. Most CEOs in tech either grew up in business and learned to talk about engineering, or grew up in engineering and never really learned to lead. I did both, and that's what makes Lumin Soft different. We don't just deliver software. We architect platforms that become the digital backbone of the organizations we serve. At Lumin Soft, we operate in high-stakes environments where the margin for error is razor-thin. Our clients don't just need software; they need a partner who understands the weight of what they're building and delivers without excuses. That's the standard I set for myself and for every engineer on my team.

name: Mayada Maged
title: Managing Partner | Global HR Outsourcing & Workforce Transformation Leader
biography: Mayada Maged is a globally recognized HR outsourcing and workforce transformation leader with over 20 years of experience in strategic growth, operational excellence, and cross-border workforce solutions. As Managing Partner of Staff Arabia, she leads integrated HR outsourcing services, including EOR, payroll, compliance, and talent management across 18+ countries. She holds an MBA in Global Management and advanced HR and management qualifications from ESLSCA Paris and AUC, and is currently pursuing a DBA in Management. Mayada has received international recognition from platforms including the Forttuna Global Excellence Awards, Stevie Awards, Global Payroll Association, CIPD PMA UK, UKCXA, and Saudi Event Awards. She also serves as Chair of Judges for the Stevie Awards in MENA and as an international jury member across leading global award platforms.

name: El-Moataz Bellah Osama
title: Strategic Cybersecurity Advisor
biography: El-Moataz Bellah Osama is a global multi-disciplinary leader and IFC-certified board director with over a decade of cybersecurity experience spanning consulting, corporate environments, and advisory boards. He brings a proven track record of driving high-stakes engagements for BFSI institutions, directing the full spectrum of cybersecurity in the FinTech sector, governing group cybersecurity architecture for Valeo, and advising PE/VC portfolio companies on leveraging cybersecurity as a competitive advantage and value creator. Strategically positioned at the intersection of cybersecurity, business strategy, and investment operations, his expertise lies in translating complex technical risks into business-driven decisions that serve as a growth enabler, EBITDA protector, and risk management anchor. This authoritative industry voice is backed by an elite portfolio of advanced credentials, including ISSAP, CSSLP, CISSP, CISM, and CMU CERT-certified.

name: Omar Elaraby
title: Corporate Strategy and Business Development
biography: Omar holds a Bachelor of Commerce (Business Management, Class of 2017) from the Ted Rogers School of Management at Toronto Metropolitan University formerly known as Ryerson University. Throughout his studies at TMU he majored in Entrepreneurship and Innovative Strategy and minored in Marketing Management. He also obtained his MMIE (Master in Management, Innovation, and Entrepreneurship, Class of 2021) from the Smith School of Business and Faculty of Science at Queen’s University. Omar is passionate about using the power of entrepreneurship and business to impact and change people's lives. During his undergraduate career, he was able to start his own social entrepreneurship business. This water filtration and sanitation business implemented in Upper Egypt was able to filter more than 150,000 litres of water to 50 different families in its first four months. After graduation, he worked with the DMZ at Ryerson University for 6 years. After the DMZ, Omar joined Highline Beta which is a consultancy group aimed to provide corporate innovation consultancy to Fortune 500 companies. In early 2023, Omar decided to move back to Egypt and join the family business ELARABY GROUP. He currently leads their Corporate Strategy and Business Development departments. In addition to supporting their International Business department by managing the South/Latin American region. Omar was able to develop a corporate innovation program at ELARABY GROUP with the establishment of ELARABY Ventures (elarabyvc.com).

name: Mohamed Tobar
title: Co-Founder & COO
biography: Mohamed Tobar is Co-founder and COO of Makkook AI, where he leads product and delivery for enterprise AI and Decision Intelligence solutions. He is also the creator of BD-OS, a framework for structuring Business Development as an operating system, and writes about growth systems, decision architecture, and enterprise execution.

name: Abdullah Elshabrawy
title: Founder
biography: Abdallah Elshabrawy is the Founder of FitNot Games, a mobile game studio crafting culturally resonant games for the 400M+ Arabic-speaking market. He has 15+ years of experience in game development across PC, web, mobile, and VR. FitNot Games has shipped 10+ games, reached 2.1M+ downloads with no paid user acquisition spend, secured a partnership with MBC Group, and have been featured by the Apple App Store twice. He is also a board member with AGE (Assembly Game Egypt), a non profit industry association for game development built to organize, connect, and grow the Egyptian game dev ecosystem.

name: Makram Abdelaziz
title: GEO HR People Operations Manager
biography: Makram Abdel Aziz is a seasoned HR and Operations leader with deep expertise spanning the full people agenda, including organizational development, talent acquisition and management, change management, succession planning, performance management, reward systems, employee relations, and policy design. He holds an MBA in Human Resources from ESLSCA Business School, Paris. At Microsoft, Makram leads People Operations for France, Germany, the Middle East & Africa, and Southeast Europe, where his impact extends well beyond HR processes to act as a catalyst for business transformation and growth. His track record includes building an HR team from the ground up across all Centers of Excellence to support Microsoft's Technical Sales organization for the Cloud business in MEA, a foundation that contributed to a fourfold increase in revenue over three years. He has also formulated and launched a Learning & Development strategy for the MEA SMB organization, led a change-management program that steered the transition of the business model and HR strategy, and coordinated global and regional learning events, HR summits, and business offsites aligned to company strategy. Alongside his corporate role, Makram is an instructor and HR/Business Management consultant known for transformative, high-impact training. Over the past decade he has delivered around 8,000 hours of programs in Organizational Development, Performance Management, Policy Design, Leadership, Coaching, and Business Process Outsourcing, helping shape industry-ready talent and fostering people-centric cultures across the region. Makram is passionate about building positive corporate cultures, leading organizations through change, and turning people strategy into measurable business results.

name: Alejandro Soumah
title: Founder
biography: Alejandro Soumah is the founder of Itô Markets, an Alliance-backed company building market infrastructure for GPU compute. He previously worked in quantitative research and credit trading at Goldman Sachs and founded RISO Data, which he grew to approximately $500K in annual recurring revenue. Alejandro studied Mathematics and Computer Science at the University of California, San Diego, and delivered a TEDxSanDiego talk on the use of AI in cocoa supply chains. His work spans artificial intelligence infrastructure, financial technology, quantitative markets, enterprise software, and technology entrepreneurship. He has also served as a judge for the Agora Agents Hackathon, evaluating AI-agent projects across technical execution, innovation, traction, and commercial potential.

name: Ahmed Shaboury
title: CEO
biography: Ahmed Shaboury is the Founder and CEO of Torasna, a heritage development company turning Egypt’s cultural assets into sustainable economic and cultural engines through public-private partnerships. He developed the business model for the Grand Egyptian Museum, the world’s largest museum dedicated to a single civilization, and co-authored the Strategic Management Plan for the Pyramids of Giza, aligning with UNESCO benchmarks and advancing sustainable tourism. As Co-Founder of Shaboury Associates, he has led 70+ visitor center and museum projects across the ancient world, including the Neom Experience Centre in Saudi Arabia and the Mleiha Archaeological Centre in the UAE. As Managing Partner at Citadel for Asset Management, he transformed Cairo’s Salah al-Din Citadel into a vibrant cultural destination through heritage-led regeneration, destination marketing, and cultural programming. Ahmed is a board member of Egypt’s General Authority for Tourism Promotion and serves on the Ministry of Tourism & Antiquities’ Experts Committee. He is a frequent speaker at international forums on heritage development, cultural tourism, and site management. Ahmed holds an M.Sc. in International Tourism Development from the University of Surrey, UK (2016), a B.Sc. in Communication Engineering (1997), and an Executive Education Diploma in Finance from London Business School. His research focuses on the sustainable development of cultural heritage destinations.

name: Mohamed Hafez
title: Managing Director
biography: Mohamed Hafez, Managing Director at Limbic Entertainment Games. Originally a programmer, with currently 15 years of experience in the video games industry. Technical roles gave me deep understanding of game development, some highlights are, Technical Director at Limbic Entertainment, Lead Programmer on Tropico 6 and Park Beyond, Engine Programmer on Memories of Mars, Game Programmer on ARK Survival Evolved, and Graphics Programmer on Final Fantasy XV. In 2022, Limbic established its branch in Cairo as extension to mother company in Germany, since then, I am proud to grow our team here in Egypt and support the game development community.

name: Osama M. Hijji
title: Group Chief Information Security Officer
biography: Osama M. Hijji is a Group CISO with 25 years of experience in Information/Cyber Security Management in various disciplines including brokerage, banking, insurance, trading, private equity, microfinance, payment, telecom, government, health, IT & military with oversight & insight in security technology, cyber defense, offensive security, governance, risk, compliance, IT security, OT/IoT security (ATMs, Phone Banking, Mobile Wallet, Mobile & Internet Banking, SCADA, Industrial Control Systems, etc..), cyber security (SOC, IRST, CERT, red teams, war-gaming, pen-testing, etc...), physical security & security intelligence (digital risk protection, brand protection, threat intelligence, attack surface management, etc..) in local, multi-national, private & public sectors firms/institutions. More and above Osama has a significant experience in IT Enterprise & Service Management. Osama holds a bachelor degree in computer engineering from Arab Academy of Sciences & Technology (AAST). He is CISM, PMP, ITIL & CSI certified in addition to having over 40 Technical, business training, and hands-on implementation and auditing experience in ISO9000, ISO20000, ISO27001, ISO22301, SAS-70, PCI-DSS, Process Management (Documentation & Auditing). Osama speaks fluently Arabic, English, French and can understand & manage with Italian. Osama has as well broad experience with multiple security technologies & products within it including next generation & legacy firewalls, IPS, Email Security Gateways, Web Security Gateways, Data Classification Enforcement, Data Leakage Prevention, Database Activity Monitoring, Encryption, Privileged Account Management, Identity & Access Management, EPP, UEBA, SIEM, SOAR, ITDR, EDR, NDR, VMDR, WAF, RASP, SAST, DAST, etc..

name: Khaled Mahfouz
title: International Presenter & Media Entrepreneur
biography: With 80+ major live stages and 100+ episodes and interviews featuring regional and international celebrities, public figures, and leading personalities, Khaled has presented across prestigious platforms including the Grand Egyptian Museum, Cairo Opera House, the Pyramids of Egypt, and major international film festivals. He is the Co-Founder & Chief Commercial Officer of BOUJ Network, a marketing and brand experience company, while also being the Creator & Host of Tesmahly Show — a distinctive conversation format that has been brought to the Red Sea International Film Festival, El Gouna Film Festival, and Cairo International Film Festival. Khaled’s presenting portfolio extends across a wide range of sectors, including technology, business, entrepreneurship, sports, entertainment, lifestyle, culture, and corporate communications. Through his work, he has presented and moderated conversations with ministers, ambassadors, CEOs, investors, entrepreneurs, industry leaders, celebrities, and leading public figures, bringing together different worlds through the power of presenting, storytelling, and meaningful conversation.

name: Sherif Gamal
title: Plastic Surgeon & Social media Influencer
biography: Dr. Sherif Gamal is a Plastic Surgeon and Social Media Influencer who has built a strong presence across digital platforms by combining his medical expertise with engaging and accessible content. Through his social media channels, he shares medical tips, health-related information, and lifestyle content, reaching millions of followers across TikTok, YouTube, Facebook, and Instagram. With his ability to communicate medical topics in a simple and relatable way, Dr. Sherif has established himself as a prominent voice in the digital healthcare space, bridging the gap between medical knowledge and social media audiences.

name: Zeyad Elhadary
title: Founder
biography: Ziad Elhadary is an Egyptian entrepreneur, dentist, and digital content creator. Founder of naydin and the better concept

name: Salah Katamish
title: .SVP - Strategy and Investment
biography: Graduated from AUC. Did my MBA in London Business School. Worked in Private Equity for 15 years before joining Madinet Masr

name: Hoda Dahroug
title: Advisor to the Minister
company: Ministry of Communications and Information Technology
biography: Eng. Hoda Dahroug • Advisor to the Minister for Digital Community Development at the Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (MCIT). • National Project Director of The Digital Transformation for Sustainable Development in Egypt at MCIT in cooperation with UNDP As a pioneer in Egypt's digital transformation, Hoda Dahroug has devoted her career to connecting technology with development, empowering communities, and driving social impact. With over 35 years of experience, she has been instrumental in shaping national policies that align with Egypt's Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), leveraging technology as a catalyst for progress. In her role as Advisor to the Minister for Digital Community Development and National Project Director of the Digital Transformation for Sustainable Development program, a collaboration between MCIT and the UNDP, she has led initiatives that have transformed the lives of thousands of women, youth, and individuals with disabilities. Projects such as Qodwa.tech and the Presidential Telemedicine Initiative, both under her leadership, have demonstrated the transformative power of digital tools in underserved communities, providing critical ICT and business skills that have opened doors to new economic and social opportunities. Her efforts extend beyond national borders, where her ability to foster cooperation between Egypt and global organizations, including the UNDP, WHO, and ILO, showcases her expertise in global partnerships. These collaborations have not only addressed global challenges but have also inspired many within the international tech community to pursue technology-driven solutions for social good. Eng.
